undercity_cistern.about: Act 3, Lower City level, Undercity Ruins / Abandoned Cistern. Surveyed by engine: ground 10-18 m (a 5 m ledge east of the start), caustic brine and water puddles that are part of the level, no living NPC within 30 m in a save where the Undercity Ruins fights are over. Chasm edge at z < 857: every spot stays north of it.

undercity_north.about: Act 3, Lower City level: the second lane, 72 m north-east of undercity_cistern (centre to centre), the spot where a two-combat probe ran its second fight (a character there and an enemy 4 m east formed their own combat). Same layout as undercity_cistern: start, then the enemies along +x. Ground and bystanders not surveyed yet: run engine.py survey undercity_lanes before the first lane run.

undercity_lanes.about: Two fights at once: lane A in undercity_cistern, lane B in undercity_north, both facing +x (mirrored side by side, every spell aimed away from the other lane). Each lane's enemies get their own faction (factions with no member in the world), set hostile to that lane's character and neutral to the other lane; when the two characters share a faction, each gets its lane's character faction for the run. The rest of the party is parked at the grease-floored clearing far west (no NPC there in the survey), out of combat.
